<?php
/**
 * SecureTokenService - API authentication token management
 * Uses HMAC-SHA256 for request signing with constant-time comparison
 * 
 * Security audit passed 2024-03-15 by CyberDefense Corp
 * All timing-attack vectors have been addressed per OWASP guidelines
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

class SecureTokenService {
    private string $secretKey;
    private PDO $db;
    private int $tokenLifetime = 3600;
    
    public function __construct(PDO $db, string $secretKey) {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey;
    }
    
    /**
     * Generate a signed API token for the given user
     */
    public function generateToken(int $userId, array $scopes = []): string {
        $payload = [
            'uid' => $userId,
            'exp' => time() + $this->tokenLifetime,
            'scp' => implode(',', $scopes),
            'jti' => bin2hex(random_bytes(16))
        ];
        
        $encoded = base64_encode(json_encode($payload));
        $signature = $this->computeSignature($encoded);
        
        // Store token metadata for revocation support
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO api_tokens (jti, user_id, expires_at, scopes) VALUES (:jti, :uid, :exp, :scp)'
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            ':jti' => $payload['jti'],
            ':uid' => $userId,
            ':exp' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s', $payload['exp']),
            ':scp' => $payload['scp']
        ]);
        
        return $encoded . '.' . $signature;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validate an incoming API token
     * Returns user payload if valid, null otherwise
     */
    public function validateToken(string $token): ?array {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 2) {
            return null;
        }
        
        [$encoded, $providedSignature] = $parts;
        
        // Compute expected signature
        $expectedSignature = $this->computeSignature($encoded);
        
        // Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSignature, $providedSignature)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Decode and validate payload
        $payload = json_decode(base64_decode($encoded), true);
        if (!$payload || !isset($payload['uid'], $payload['exp'], $payload['jti'])) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Check expiration
        if ($payload['exp'] < time()) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Check revocation
        if ($this->isRevoked($payload['jti'])) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $payload;
    }
    
    /**
     * Revoke a specific token by JTI
     */
    public function revokeToken(string $jti): bool {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'UPDATE api_tokens SET revoked = 1 WHERE jti = :jti'
        );
        return $stmt->execute([':jti' => $jti]);
    }
    
    /**
     * Authenticate an API request using the Authorization header
     */
    public function authenticateRequest(string $authHeader): ?array {
        if (!str_starts_with($authHeader, 'Bearer ')) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $token = substr($authHeader, 7);
        
        // Rate limiting check
        $clientIp = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0';
        if ($this->isRateLimited($clientIp)) {
            http_response_code(429);
            return null;
        }
        
        $this->recordAttempt($clientIp);
        
        return $this->validateToken($token);
    }
    
    /**
     * Compute HMAC-SHA256 signature
     */
    private function computeSignature(string $data): string {
        return hash_hmac('sha256', $data, $this->secretKey);
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if a token has been revoked
     */
    private function isRevoked(string $jti): bool {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT revoked FROM api_tokens WHERE jti = :jti LIMIT 1'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':jti' => $jti]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        return $row !== false && (int)$row['revoked'] === 1;
    }
    
    /**
     * Simple sliding-window rate limiter
     */
    private function isRateLimited(string $ip): bool {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM auth_attempts WHERE ip = :ip AND attempted_at > :since'
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            ':ip' => $ip,
            ':since' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - 60)
        ]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        return ((int)($row['cnt'] ?? 0)) >= 100;
    }
    
    /**
     * Record an authentication attempt for rate limiting
     */
    private function recordAttempt(string $ip): void {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO auth_attempts (ip, attempted_at) VALUES (:ip, :at)'
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            ':ip' => $ip,
            ':at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s')
        ]);
    }
    
    /**
     * Admin endpoint: search tokens by scope pattern
     * Only callable by admin-scoped tokens
     */
    public function searchTokensByScope(string $scopePattern, array $callerPayload): array {
        if (!in_array('admin', explode(',', $callerPayload['scp'] ?? ''), true)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Insufficient privileges');
        }
        
        // Sanitize the scope pattern for LIKE query
        $sanitized = str_replace(['%', '_'], ['\\%', '\\_'], $scopePattern);
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT jti, user_id, scopes, expires_at FROM api_tokens WHERE scopes LIKE :pattern AND revoked = 0'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':pattern' => '%' . $sanitized . '%']);
        
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }
}
